source.variant: Original independently published ZABW gzip-compressed AbiWord XML fixture; one gzip member with FNAME hello.abw and native AWML payload. Not an agent-created gzip of the ABW fixture.
source.coverageLimit: Only this original ZABW gzip member and its actual XML; EOF/no extra members, decompression bound, CRC/ISIZE, one hello world paragraph, ordinary type/one section, effective encoded Times New Roman12pt/left/Letter dimensions. Inner bytes happen to equal prior ABW source; earlier runtime outcomes are not transferred. No ZABW export/other compression variants/fonts installed/rendering/metadata/history/RDF/richer AWML/native GUI/full-format acceptance.

parserReferences.role: Official producer importer/exporter/property definitions consulted for namespace, style/property inheritance and native XML vocabulary only; not executed as oracle. Direct original source XML supplies expectations.

reusedXMLReader.role: Exact unchanged source-XML reader reused only after byte-for-byte decompressed XML identity was verified; no inherited ABW runtime pass.
reusedXMLReader.hashBasis: Canonical Git blob bytes; CRLF worktree bytes normalized only when checking local execution file against Git

containerReference.description: RFC1952 gzip header/trailer, Deflate method, CRC32 and ISIZE semantics; bounded one-member fixture proof, not a general gzip-conformance claim.
